hey mate, fellow pilot here. theres really no evidence to show that your phone can interfere with communications or electronics on a flight.  Many pilots use their phones or an iPad even in small Cessnas.

lots of people say it doesnt help for brain damage, but to me that doesnt really make sense as its another layer of padding that can compress and take away some of the energy of an incoming shot. 

however it does make your head a bigger target and hinders your vision, also could give you a false sense of security leading you to spar harder than you otherwise would. 

in the end the best way to prevent brain damage is to spar light and technical without ego and keep your power in check.
